solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option B i.e. 70.

 

GIVEN

 

• Expression: 21 ÷ 5 − 25 + 180 × 3, with + ↔ − and × ↔ ÷ interchanged.

 

SOLUTION

 

• Replace each symbol with its swapped counterpart: ÷ becomes ×, − becomes +, + becomes −, × becomes ÷.

 

• New expression: 21 × 5 + 25 − 180 ÷ 3.

 

• Apply order of operations: 21 × 5 = 105; 180 ÷ 3 = 60.

 

• Now compute: 105 + 25 − 60 = 130 − 60 = 70.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option B.

 

SHORT TRICK

 

• First rewrite the entire expression with symbols swapped (do this in one pass, carefully, on paper), then solve it normally using VBODMAS — trying to swap and calculate simultaneously often leads to errors.

 

NOTE

 

• Interchanging '+'/'−' and '×'/'÷' is purely a symbol swap — the numbers themselves never move or change, only the operators between them.

question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 7 1 8 3 3 1 5 4 8 5 1 4 4 9 5 9 6 8 7 3 5 3 6 6 9 (Right)

How many such digits are there each of which is immediately preceded by a perfect square and also immediately followed by a perfect square?

(Note: 1 is also a perfect square)
solution_text:

question:

'A ? B' means 'A is the daughter of B',

'A = B' means 'A is the wife of B',

'A @ B' means 'A is the mother of B' and

'A √ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

How is C related to L if 'C @ D ? E √ F = L'?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option C i.e. Wife's mother.

 

GIVEN

 

• 'C @ D ? E √ F = L', with @ = mother of, ? = daughter of, √ = father of, = = wife of.

 

SOLUTION

 

• C @ D: C is the mother of D.

 

• D ? E: D is the daughter of E ⇒ E is a parent of D.

 

• E √ F: E is the father of F ⇒ E is male, confirming E is D's father (and, together with C, the mother, forms D's parent couple); F is E's child, i.e., D's sibling.

 

• F = L: F is the wife of L ⇒ L is F's husband.

 

• Since C is the mother of D, and D and F are siblings (both children of C and E), C is also the mother of F.

 

• Since F is L's wife, and C is F's mother, C is L's wife's mother.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option C.

 

SHORT TRICK

 

• In blood-relation coded puzzles, decode the expression strictly left to right, one symbol at a time, building a family tree as you go (mark gender wherever a father/mother/husband/wife clue reveals it) — this prevents confusion in longer chains.

question: Seven boxes M, N, O, P, Q, R, and S are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept above S. Only one box is kept between R and S. question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All necks are faces.

Some necks are arms.

Conclusions:

(I): All arms are necks.

(II): Some faces are arms.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option C i.e. Only II follows.

 

GIVEN

 

• Statements: All necks are faces. Some necks are arms.

 

SOLUTION

 

• Venn picture: 'necks' is entirely inside 'faces' (All necks are faces). 'Arms' overlaps partially with 'necks' (Some necks are arms).

 

• Conclusion (I): 'All arms are necks' — We only know *some* necks are arms, i.e., some overlap exists; it does NOT mean the entire 'arms' set lies inside 'necks'. This does not follow.

 

• Conclusion (II): 'Some faces are arms' — Since 'necks' is wholly inside 'faces', and part of 'necks' overlaps with 'arms', that overlapping part is also inside 'faces'. So at least some 'arms' must also be 'faces' — this does follow by the standard syllogism rule (All A are B + Some A are C ⇒ Some B are C).

 

• So only Conclusion (II) is valid.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option C.

 

SHORT TRICK

 

• Standard syllogism rule: 'All A are B' + 'Some A are C' ⇒ 'Some B are C' always follows — memorising this combination pattern helps instantly resolve such questions.

 

NOTE

 

• Never reverse a 'Some A are B' statement into 'All B are A' — 'Some' statements only guarantee partial overlap, never a complete containment.

question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G, are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only five people sit between D and F. G sits to the immediate left of F. Only one person sits between G and A. question: F, G, H, I, M, N and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between F and G, when counted from the right of F. solution_text:

• Final clockwise order: F(0) - H(1) - I(2) - G(3) - N(4) - O(5) - M(6).

 

• Third to the left (counter-clockwise) of O(5): 5 − 3 = 2, which is I.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option A.

 

SHORT TRICK

 

• Convert every 'X people between P and Q, counted from the right of P' clue directly into P + (X+1) = Q (using consistent clockwise numbering), solve the resulting simultaneous equations, then place any remaining people in the leftover positions using the smaller clues.

question: As of June 2025, who announced the decision to host Khelo India Northeast Games every year?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Mansukh Mandaviya.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• As of June 2025, Mansukh Mandaviya, the Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports, announced the decision to host the Khelo India Northeast Games on an annual basis, reinforcing the government's commitment to sports development in India's northeastern states. (खेलो इंडिया नॉर्थईस्ट गेम्स — मनसुख मांडविया)

 

• Khelo India is the Government of India's flagship national sports development programme, aimed at building a strong grassroots sports culture and identifying and nurturing talent across the country.

 

• Making the Khelo India Northeast Games an annual event is intended to give consistent competitive opportunities to athletes from the northeastern region, which has historically produced many top Indian sportspersons.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option A.

 

Additional Information

 

• The Khelo India scheme was launched in 2018, encompassing various components like Khelo India School Games, Khelo India University Games, and Khelo India Winter Games.

 

• Mansukh Mandaviya has held the Youth Affairs and Sports portfolio in the Union Council of Ministers, overseeing India's sports development policy.

 

• India's northeastern states are known for producing outstanding athletes in disciplines like boxing, archery, football and weightlifting.

 

NOTE

 

• Gajendra Singh Shekhawat (Option B) holds a different Union ministerial portfolio; Narendra Modi (Option C) is the Prime Minister of India but was not specifically the one who made this particular announcement; Dharmendra Pradhan (Option D) handles the Education portfolio — none of these three made this specific announcement.

question: What was the purpose of Operation Brahma, launched by India in March 2025?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Earthquake relief.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• Operation Brahma, launched by India in March 2025, was a humanitarian relief mission in response to a devastating earthquake in Myanmar, reflecting India's role as a 'first responder' to disasters in its neighbourhood. (ऑपरेशन ब्रह्मा — म्यांमार भूकंप राहत)

 

• Under this operation, India dispatched relief materials, medical teams, search-and-rescue personnel (including NDRF units), and essential supplies to support Myanmar in the aftermath of the earthquake.

 

• The operation is consistent with India's long-standing foreign policy approach of 'Neighbourhood First' and its practice of extending prompt humanitarian assistance during regional disasters.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option C.

 

Additional Information

 

• India has conducted several similarly named humanitarian and evacuation operations in the past, such as Operation Dost (2023, Turkey-Syria earthquake relief) and Operation Kaveri (2023, evacuation from Sudan).

 

• The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) is India's specialised force for domestic and international disaster response operations.

 

• India's disaster relief diplomacy is often seen as a key component of its soft power and regional leadership in South and Southeast Asia.

 

NOTE

 

• Military exercise (Option A), War extradition (Option B) and Tsunami relief (Option D) do not correctly describe the purpose of Operation Brahma, which was specifically an earthquake relief mission.

question: Which of the following countries hosted the 2025 ISSF World Cup in Rifle/Pistol shooting?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Germany.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• The 2025 ISSF (International Shooting Sport Federation) World Cup in Rifle/Pistol shooting was hosted by Germany, at its well-established shooting sport venue, continuing Germany's long tradition of hosting major international shooting events. (आईएसएसएफ विश्व कप 2025 — जर्मनी)

 

• The ISSF World Cup series is held across multiple countries each year in various shooting disciplines (rifle, pistol, and shotgun), serving as key qualification and ranking events for shooters ahead of the Olympic Games.

 

• Indian shooters regularly compete in ISSF World Cup events, and India has produced numerous world-class shooters who have won medals at various World Cup legs.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option D.

 

Additional Information

 

• The International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) is the world governing body for Olympic shooting sports, headquartered in Munich, Germany.

 

• India itself has hosted ISSF World Cup events in the past, notably in New Delhi, at facilities like the Dr. Karni Singh Shooting Range.

 

• Prominent Indian shooters in recent years include Manu Bhaker, Saurabh Chaudhary, Elavenil Valarivan and Sift Kaur Samra.

 

NOTE

 

• Peru (Option A), India (Option B) and Egypt (Option C) have hosted various international shooting events at different times, but the specific 2025 ISSF World Cup in Rifle/Pistol referenced here was hosted by Germany.
